headline: Mooring County Line Erupts as Fronts Jostle
war_summary: The latest returns put Mooring County at the head of the battle ledger: 55 strategic-base events in 24 hours, including 18 in six hours and 10 in the latest two-hour watch. Its holdings remain finely divided—six Colonial, five Warden and one neutral—while casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating. Weathered Expanse is likewise unsettled, with 35 daily events, four in the latest two hours, and a nine-base spread of four Colonial, two Warden and three neutral positions; enlistments are rising there as well. Callums Cape recorded 35 events over the day and remains split four Colonial to three Warden, though its immediate event log has gone quiet. Linn Mercy also totals 35 daily events and retains ten Colonial bases plus one neutral site, but no event appeared in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow’s contested line has eased to 13 daily events, with three holdings apiece and two neutral. Stonecradle shows nine daily events amid nine Colonial bases, while much of the wider map reports little or no recent base movement. The next day’s ownership clues are therefore concentrated in the divided districts, especially Mooring and Weathered.
